observations: Dark-colored base with four visible legs.
Small decorative items (Eiffel Tower, hourglass, golden figure) placed on the tabletop.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ADEBANJO PROMISE' across both photos.
Background shows a keyboard on a stand and an office chair.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Structural instability or wobbling of the base.
risks.proof: Video of the table being shaken to test for movement.

risks.risk: Hidden scratches, dents, or stains on the tabletop surface.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tabletop surface under even light.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged side panels or drawers.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and any storage compartments.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the table being shaken to check for wobbling.
Close-up photos of the tabletop surface to check for scratches or stains.
Photos of the table from all sides to check for missing panels or drawers.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a center table from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case even though the seller's condition claims are unverified.
